probes.why: the two 16-slot bounds HP1's entire safety argument rests on -- cmp cx,10h in IsLocallyControlled and cmp dx,10h in PeerTime -- read out of the MAPPED image rather than the file on disk, because a detour lands in memory and W1-C's first real sweep was refused for exactly that. Plus the prologues of the five functions E-4 calls through a pointer and the eight it reasons about, and a known-answer control so a comparison that always agreed cannot report a green it did not earn. If a bound is patched the synthetic owner is unsafe and W1-E's match probes must not run
